text:
maria: Hatching RC candidate 2.1.0-build.872. Need QA signoff and artifact pin before promo window (02:00 UTC tonight). Can someone take smoke?

sam: On it. I'll run the smoke checklist and KV warm. ETA 15m. @alex can you stand by for any quick fixes?

alex: I'm available. What's the artifact tag?

maria: artifact: redwood-api:2.1.0-872 and runtime-image: r-infer:3.4. Pin request submitted in release-dex.

deploy-bot: [info] Pin request received: artifact=redwood-api:2.1.0-872, pin_id=pin_9932. CI status: all checks passed. Can promote after signoffs.

sam: Smoke started: running ./scripts/smoke.sh --env=staging --artifact=redwood-api:2.1.0-872

alex: Smoke logs: 3 failures timeout->inference queue. Investigating; likely KV warm mismatch.

maria: Good catch. add a KV warm step before canary. Kyra, can you increase canary to 5% for KV warm baseline?

kyra: yep, bumping canary to 5% now. Also setting autoscale min_replicas=2 for the window.

jordan: What's our rollback plan if latency climbs? we should pin fallback model variant.

maria: Rollback: immediate traffic shift to redwood-api:2.0.9 and fallback to quantized-variant q-2.1.0 if needed. Manual rollback steps in release playbook.

sam: Smoke green after KV warm. All endpoints responding in <120ms median on staging. Ready for signoff. :thumbsup:

maria: QA signoff: done. Release notes updated in PR. Tagging release docs.

deploy-bot: [action] Scheduling promo: env=prod, window=2026-04-01T02:00:00Z, artifact=redwood-api:2.1.0-872, canary=5%. Initiating preflight 30m before.

jordan: Confirming oncall coverage during promo window. Sam will be sheriff.

sam: I'll be oncall. Keep rollback runbook open.

maria: Promo go/no-go at -10m in this thread. If no objections, proceed.

kyra: No objections. Monitoring dashboards configured.

deploy-bot: [notice] Preflight checks passed. All services healthy. Promo triggered at 2026-04-01T02:00:00Z.

deploy-bot: [success] Canary deploy complete. Metrics: error_rate=0.12% (baseline 0.11%), p95 latency +8ms. Holding 15m for observation.

sam: Observing metrics, slight p95 bump but within SLO. continuing hold.

jordan: After 15m hold looks stable. Approve full rollout.

deploy-bot: [success] Full promotion complete. Artifact pinned: pin_9932. Release complete.

maria: Awesome. I'll send release notes and close the pin. Thanks everyone.
